title: Banana oat bake
steps: Preheat the oven to 350°F and grease a square baking pan.
In a large bowl, mash the bananas. Mix in the eggs, vanilla extract, and maple syrup.
Stir in the oats, baking powder, and salt until just combined.
Fold in 1/2 cup of the chocolate chips, pour the batter into the pan, and top with the remaining chocolate chips.
expected: Preheat the oven to 350°F and grease a square baking pan.
In a large bowl, mash {3 ripe bananas}. Mix in {3 eggs}, {1 teaspoon vanilla extract}, and {1/4 cup maple syrup}.
Stir in {2 cup rolled oats}, {2 teaspoon baking powder}, and {1/2 teaspoon salt} until just combined.
Fold in 1/2 cup of the chocolate chips, pour the batter into the pan, and top with the remaining chocolate chips.

title: Garlic green beans
steps: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the green beans and cook until bright green, about 5 minutes.
Add garlic and cook 1 minute more. Season with the salt and pepper.
Toss the beans with the lemon juice and serve.
expected: Heat {2 tablespoon olive oil} in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add {1 pound green beans} and cook until bright green, about 5 minutes.
Add {3 garlic cloves} and cook 1 minute more. Season with {1/2 teaspoon kosher salt} and {1/4 teaspoon black pepper}.
Toss the beans with {1 tablespoon lemon juice} and serve.

title: Peanut sesame noodles
steps: Cook the rice noodles according to the package. Reserve some of the cooking water.
Whisk together the peanut butter, soy sauce, sesame oil, rice vinegar, and chili crisp. Thin the sauce with the noodle water.
Toss the noodles in the peanut butter sauce and top with sliced green onions.
expected: Cook {8 ounce rice noodles} according to the package. Reserve some of the cooking water.

Whisk together {1/4 cup creamy peanut butter}, {2 tablespoon soy sauce}, {1 tablespoon toasted sesame oil}, {1 tablespoon rice vinegar}, and {1 teaspoon chili crisp}. Thin the sauce with the noodle water.
Toss the noodles in the peanut butter sauce and top with sliced {2 green onions}.

title: Chicken and white bean stew
steps: Heat the oil in a large pot. Add the onion and carrots and cook until soft.
Add the boneless, skinless chicken thighs and the broth and simmer 20 minutes.
Stir in the beans and the spinach. Season with salt and pepper.
expected: Heat {2 tablespoon olive oil} in a large pot. Add {1 yellow onion} and {2 carrots} and cook until soft.
Add {3/2 pound boneless, skinless chicken thighs} and {4 cup chicken broth} and simmer 20 minutes.
Stir in {3 cup cooked white beans} and {4 cup baby spinach}. Season with salt and pepper.

title: Brown butter cookies
steps: Melt the butter in a saucepan and cook until browned. Let the butter cool.
Beat the browned butter with the brown sugar, granulated sugar, and egg.
Add the flour and baking soda and mix. Fold in the chocolate chips and chill the dough.
expected: Melt {1 cup unsalted butter} in a saucepan and cook until browned. Let the butter cool.
Beat the browned butter with {1/3 cup brown sugar}, {1/3 cup granulated sugar}, and {1 egg}.
Add {2 cup all-purpose flour} and {1 teaspoon baking soda} and mix. Fold in {1 cup chocolate chips} and chill the dough.
